Calculator.title: Material and quote calculator
Calculator.description: Work out timber volume (m³) and cost, extra items and VAT (KDV) on one screen. Share the result as a link, an image or a PDF.
Calculator.categoryLinkText: Work out timber m³, extra items and the total with VAT.

how.volume: Each row's volume is thickness × width × length × pieces. Dimensions are converted from the unit you pick (mm, cm or m) to metres, and the result is shown in cubic metres (m³).
how.example: Example: 10 pieces of 5 × 10 cm timber, 400 cm long, make 0.2 m³. At 20,000 ₺ per m³ that is 4,000 ₺, or 4,800 ₺ with 20% VAT.
how.extras: The waste percentage is added to the timber volume and cost. Extra items (screws, paint, delivery, labour) add up as quantity × unit price.
how.vat: Prices you enter exclude VAT. VAT is calculated on the subtotal rounded to the kuruş, so the lines on screen always add up to the total.

limits.prices: You enter the prices; the tool never suggests one.
limits.estimate: Results are estimates; an exact price needs a site visit.
limits.privacy: Your calculation stays on this device and in links you share. It is not saved on our server.

ui.metaHint: What you fill in here appears in the share link, the image and the PDF.
ui.wasteHint: Added to the volume and the timber cost.
ui.extrasHint: Screws, paint, delivery, labour and the like.
ui.disclaimer: Results are estimates; an exact price needs a site visit.
